record.paper_title: Billiard dynamics: A survey with the emphasis on open problems
record.original_question: For an irrational polygon P, let f_P(ℓ) be the number of periodic strips of length at most ℓ. Find nontrivial upper and lower bounds for f_P(ℓ).

evidence.quote: Задача 11. Найти нетривиальную (верхнюю и нижнюю) оценки для fP для иррациональных многоугольников.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $P \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ be a simple polygon at least one of whose interior angles is an irrational multiple of $\pi$ (an "irrational polygon"). Consider the billiard flow inside $P$: a point particle moves in straight lines and reflects elastically off the sides (with the usual convention that trajectories hitting vertices are undefined). A periodic billiard trajectory in $P$ comes in a maximal parallel family of periodic trajectories of the same length, called a periodic strip; let the length of such a strip be the common length of its periodic trajectories. For $\ell > 0$, define
$$f_P(\ell) = \#\{\text{periodic strips in } P \text{ of length at most } \ell\}.$$
Find nontrivial upper and lower bounds, valid for every irrational polygon $P$ (or for generic such $P$), on the growth of $f_P(\ell)$ as $\ell \to \infty$.
artifact.status_search_result: For rational polygons, quadratic upper and lower bounds (in $\ell$) for the count of periodic strips are classical (Masur). For irrational polygons very little is known: Hooper and Schwartz showed the existence of irrational polygons where $f_P(\ell)$ grows superlinearly (faster than $\ell \log^k \ell$ for any $k$), but no nontrivial general upper and lower bounds for $f_P$ that hold for all (or generic) irrational polygons are known. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Lower bounds on growth rates of periodic billiard trajectories in some irrational polygons
status_evidence.snippet: There exist irrational polygons P where f_P(n), the number of periodic billiard paths of length at most n, grows superlinearly; for any k there is an open set of polygons where f_P(n) grows faster than n log^k n.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial lower bounds are known in special families of irrational polygons; no general nontrivial bounds are established.

status_evidence.title: Rational billiards and flat structures (Masur–Tabachnikov)
status_evidence.snippet: For polygons with angles irrational multiples of π, very little is known about counting periodic trajectories.
status_evidence.claim: The counting problem for periodic strips in irrational polygons is acknowledged as open.

status_evidence.title: Survey Lecture on Billiards (Schwartz)
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of periodic orbits in irrational polygons and lack of asymptotic counting results.
status_evidence.claim: Nontrivial bounds for f_P in general irrational polygons are not known.
